basis: The live pricing-feed rows anchored on https://kie.ai/minimax-h3-image?model=minimax-h3%2Ftext-to-image and the live GET /api/v1/models pricingDesc agree: each output image bills by its total pixels, 1.8 credits (0.009 USD) up to 4.5 MP, which covers the 1K and 2K tiers, and 5.5 credits (0.0275 USD) up to 20 MP (4K). The docs map a custom width x height to a tier by its total pixels: up to 1,200,000 as 1K, up to 4,500,000 as 2K, anything larger as 4K. Text-to-image takes no input image, so there is no input-image extra. The docs callback example carries no creditsConsumed figure. The recording below billed 1.8 at submission.

entry.title: MiniMax H3 Text To Image
entry.pricingDesc:
Billed per image by total output pixels: 1.8 credits ($0.009) up to 4.5 MP (1K / 2K) and 5.5 credits ($0.0275) up to 20 MP (4K) — about 60% below official pricing.

High-tier top-ups come with bonus credits that lower the effective price by about 10%.

docs.tierRule: width x height: up to 1,200,000 pixels -> 1K, up to 4,500,000 -> 2K, above -> 4K (e.g. 1920 x 1080 -> 2K, 3840 x 2160 -> 4K)
